1x-neo.author: Jason Nelson
1x-neo.summary: Reports that the WSJ demo of NEO was fully tele-operated and slow, and relays expert and reviewer skepticism that the product is premature.
1x-neo.quote: Fetching a water bottle from a refrigerator 10 feet away took over a minute, while loading a few dishes into a dishwasher took more than five minutes.

1x-neo.author: Nicole Dominikowski
1x-neo.summary: Summarises the WSJ test: slow at fetching a bottle and unable to crack a walnut, but good with a vacuum cleaner, and the tested unit was remotely operated.
1x-neo.quote: It took the robot a full minute and seven seconds to retrieve a bottle of water from the refrigerator and hand it to the test subject a few steps away.

figure-02.author: Jason Del Rey
figure-02.summary: Questions whether the CEO exaggerated the BMW deployment, citing BMW that a single robot did a limited chore and earlier ran only off-hours.
figure-02.quote: a closer look at the details of the partnership reveals a far more modest affair

aldebaran-pepper.summary: A 3-week grocery store field experiment found Pepper mostly seen as entertainment, with sceptical employees who saw no workload reduction.
aldebaran-pepper.quote: The three employees we interviewed all seemed quite skeptical about Pepper in the store.

engineered-arts-ameca.publisher: Robots for the Rest of Us
engineered-arts-ameca.author: David Berreby
engineered-arts-ameca.summary: A writer who met Ameca at ICRA found it clearly non-human and rather canned in conversation, though still emotionally engaging.
engineered-arts-ameca.quote: it did not act like a person, with its eerily calm voice, unnaturally even intonation, and somewhat pat responses.

agibot-x2-ultra.summary: Hands-on at the AgiBot UK launch event (X2 series): the robots on show were human-controlled and the X2 has no autonomous speech yet.
agibot-x2-ultra.quote: The Agibot X2 has nothing of its own to say yet, but with further development towards autonomy, that could soon change

agibot-x2-neo.summary: Hands-on at the AgiBot UK launch event (X2 series): the robots on show were human-controlled and the X2 has no autonomous speech yet.
agibot-x2-neo.quote: The Agibot X2 has nothing of its own to say yet, but with further development towards autonomy, that could soon change

agibot-x2-edu.summary: Hands-on at the AgiBot UK launch event (X2 series): the robots on show were human-controlled and the X2 has no autonomous speech yet.
agibot-x2-edu.quote: The Agibot X2 has nothing of its own to say yet, but with further development towards autonomy, that could soon change

agibot-a2-ultra.author: Aki Ukita
agibot-a2-ultra.summary: CES 2026 show-floor encounter with the AgiBot A2 (A2 series) found its interaction natural and at human pace.
agibot-a2-ultra.quote: The A2’s digital face helped make that moment feel approachable rather than uncanny.

agibot-a2-max.author: Aki Ukita
agibot-a2-max.summary: CES 2026 show-floor encounter with the AgiBot A2 (A2 series) found its interaction natural and at human pace.
agibot-a2-max.quote: The A2’s digital face helped make that moment feel approachable rather than uncanny.

agibot-a2-lite.author: Aki Ukita
agibot-a2-lite.summary: CES 2026 show-floor encounter with the AgiBot A2 (A2 series) found its interaction natural and at human pace.
agibot-a2-lite.quote: The A2’s digital face helped make that moment feel approachable rather than uncanny.

agibot-a2-w.author: Aki Ukita
agibot-a2-w.summary: CES 2026 show-floor encounter with the AgiBot A2 (A2 series) found its interaction natural and at human pace.
agibot-a2-w.quote: The A2’s digital face helped make that moment feel approachable rather than uncanny.

keenon-xman-r1.summary: Comments on the LEAP East 2026 coffee-service demo, noting it is a company-described demonstration and the robot works alongside dedicated delivery and cleaning robots.
keenon-xman-r1.quote: Those are company-described demonstrations, not independent proof of a ready-for-everywhere retail system.

unitree-g1-edu.summary: A robotics lab reports its first two weeks with the G1 dev unit, finding the SDK usable after fixes but documented debug mode and ROS 2 motion examples not working and few advanced examples.
unitree-g1-edu.quote: Scripts do not work in the robot’s debug mode, although according to the docs they should.

unitree-g1.summary: LORIA lab calls the G1 reliable and quick to set up, but reports difficulties with its hands.
unitree-g1.quote: the team reported some difficulties with the hands, which should be taken into account for manipulation projects or applications involving interaction with objects

unitree-h1.summary: LAAS-CNRS reports the H1 walks almost immediately and is robust under aggressive reinforcement-learning policies.
unitree-h1.quote: Despite executing commands described as particularly “violent”, the robot continued to operate normally.

unitree-r1.summary: TechRadar welcomes the price but doubts the R1 is ready for homes and says its autonomy is unclear.
unitree-r1.quote: So while the Unitree R1 might be pitched as a home helper robot, it's hardly ready to be in anyone's home.

sanctuary-ai-phoenix.summary: New Atlas finds a Phoenix demo notably fast and autonomous, based on an interview with the co-founder; it also notes hydraulic hands leak and are costly.
sanctuary-ai-phoenix.quote: working totally autonomously at near-human speeds – much faster than Tesla's or Figure's robots

tesla-optimus.summary: Electrek calls the upgraded hand demo impressive but teleoperated, and recalls Tesla not disclosing teleoperation at its earlier event.
tesla-optimus.quote: Tesla has unveiled a new and upgraded hand for its Optimus humanoid robot and released an impressive albeit still teleoperated demonstration.

tesla-optimus.author: Daniel Zlatev
tesla-optimus.summary: Notebookcheck reports an Optimus drink-serving robot at a Tesla event fell over, apparently due to its teleoperator.
tesla-optimus.quote: the move looked suspiciously as if an absent-minded teleoperator got off their place and removed the headset

xiaomi-cyberone.author: Evan Ackerman
xiaomi-cyberone.summary: IEEE Spectrum's robotics editor argues from Xiaomi's own press release that CyberOne itself is probably not meant to be very useful, while welcoming more humanoid work.
xiaomi-cyberone.quote: CyberOne itself is probably not intended to be all that useful.

xiaomi-cyberone.author: Evan Ackerman
xiaomi-cyberone.summary: IEEE Spectrum's robotics editor argues from Xiaomi's own press release that CyberOne itself is probably not meant to be very useful, while welcoming more humanoid work.
xiaomi-cyberone.quote: CyberOne itself is probably not intended to be all that useful.

unitree-go2-pro.author: Ben Coxworth
unitree-go2-pro.summary: Reviewer finds the Go2 Pro impressive and attention-grabbing but questions what it is for once the novelty of its tricks wears off.
unitree-go2-pro.quote: The Go2 Pro is certainly an impressive piece of kit, it's excellent at doing the things that it does, and it will most definitely turn heads wherever you take it.

unitree-go2-pro.summary: Review calls the Go2 Pro agile and entertaining but not a dependable household assistant, better suited to enthusiasts, education or research.
unitree-go2-pro.quote: It is agile, entertaining and technically interesting. It is not a mechanical butler.

boston-dynamics-spot.author: Lori Dorn
boston-dynamics-spot.summary: Write-up of Marques Brownlee's day with Spot notes the robot self-rights after falls and that he came away positive.
boston-dynamics-spot.quote: All in all, Brownlee had a very good day with Spot and had at least one fear put to rest.

boston-dynamics-stretch.summary: A DHL Supply Chain executive praises Stretch's intuitiveness and its autonomous recovery when boxes shift.
boston-dynamics-stretch.quote: Stretch is quite intuitive. If the environment changes - if a box shifts off a place or drops to the side - its autonomous exception recovery is outstanding

diligent-robotics-moxi.author: Varsha Bansal
diligent-robotics-moxi.summary: Investigation reports nurses at MultiCare hospitals found Moxi often lost, needed a human handler, and was dropped by two hospitals.
diligent-robotics-moxi.quote: It frequently lost its way in hospital corridors, cried for help when faced with elevator buttons, and ping-ponged before elevator doors, unable to discern which lift to take.

canvas-1200cx.summary: Webcor's innovation lead says the Canvas drywall finishing robot's work exceeded expectations and helps deliver faster and more reliably, though humans still do final touch-ups.
canvas-1200cx.quote: This has increased our ability to deliver faster and more reliably,

canvas-1200cx.summary: A Canvas innovation-partner drywall contractor reports being impressed by the Level 5 finish quality of the robot, with a finisher initially skeptical.
canvas-1200cx.quote: I am just blown away by the quality. The Level 5 is pretty phenomenal.

canvas-2000cx.summary: Webcor's innovation lead says the Canvas drywall finishing robot's work exceeded expectations and helps deliver faster and more reliably, though humans still do final touch-ups.
canvas-2000cx.quote: This has increased our ability to deliver faster and more reliably,

canvas-2000cx.summary: A Canvas innovation-partner drywall contractor reports being impressed by the Level 5 finish quality of the robot, with a finisher initially skeptical.
canvas-2000cx.quote: I am just blown away by the quality. The Level 5 is pretty phenomenal.

construction-robotics-sam.summary: The general contractor's project manager could not quantify savings from the robots, seeing them as schedule and cost certainty rather than a big cost reducer.
construction-robotics-sam.quote: I don't think it's a large cost reducer, but it could be a scheduling reducer.

hilti-jaibot.summary: Trade magazine notes Hilti's 40 percent faster claim from a Rostock case has no published comparison method and the 1000 holes per day figure is not a proven site average.
hilti-jaibot.quote: Eine nachvollziehbare Vergleichsmethodik wird dort allerdings nicht veröffentlicht.

dusty-robotics-fieldprinter-2.summary: Cites a 2025 study of Dusty Robotics layout on an eight-storey Los Angeles medical office building (observed Oct 2022 to Jan 2023, so the first-generation robot) with lower labour and shorter marking time versus an estimated manual process.
dusty-robotics-fieldprinter-2.quote: Gegenüber einem geschätzten manuellen Ablauf sank der Arbeitsaufwand um 68 %. Die Dauer der Markierungsarbeiten verkürzte sich um 18 %.

hundegger-robot-drive.author: Martina Nöstler
hundegger-robot-drive.summary: A Swiss timber construction owner who replaced a competitor's joining machine reports going from sceptic to satisfied Robot-Drive user.
hundegger-robot-drive.quote: I went from being a sceptical Hundegger customer to a satisfied Robot-Drive user.

acr-tybot.summary: The owner of a Wisconsin rebar subcontractor, quoted in the maker's release as relayed by Construction Dive, says TyBOT helped finish a bridge job on time and on budget.
acr-tybot.quote: Having TyBOT on our jobsite was a major asset to our crew as they finished the project on time and on budget,

hp-siteprint.summary: Skanska's layout contractor Siteline360 reports printing a wall layout over 2,400 sq ft in 45 minutes with SitePrint, versus a longer manual job.
hp-siteprint.quote: it took construction services provider Siteline360 45 minutes to print the layout of walls over an area of 2,400 square feet.

hp-siteprint.summary: A self-described commercial layout specialist calls it a nice gadget but warns it cannot catch errors in architects' drawings.
hp-siteprint.quote: architects rarely see the building they are designing space for and therefore they make a lot of errors which have to be corrected in the field or referred back to the architect.

okibo-eg7.summary: A PCI worker on the Netflix House project says sanding with the Okibo robot left him far less exhausted than a traditional power sander; the article is a joint Okibo/PCI announcement and does not name the exact robot model.
okibo-eg7.quote: I used a traditional power sander in one of the largest rooms on this job, and it took me all day. I was physically exhausted. Then I used the Okibo robot in an identical room, and I didn't feel drained at all.

teleo-supervised-autonomy.author: Scott Lyons (Tomahawk Construction), quoted
teleo-supervised-autonomy.summary: The owner of Tomahawk Construction says Teleo units kept his haul trucks staffed and let one operator run three trucks.
teleo-supervised-autonomy.quote: Ever since we have installed Teleo units on the trucks, we haven't had one sitting. It lets us expand who we would typically hire for a haul truck. So today we'll see one operator per three trucks.
